scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && pnpm build:film
scripts.build:film: esbuild src/film-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --sourcemap --outfile=dist/film-worker.mjs --external:@napi-rs/canvas --external:node-web-audio-api --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp ../web/assets/og/press-start-2p-*.woff dist/fonts/
scripts.build:native: cargo build --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p dist && cp native/target/release/libmassovka_film.so dist/massovka-film.node
